newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PNB H1 net profit at 955 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: PNB H1 net profit at 955 mln pesos.

text.p: Philippine National Bank said on Wednesday its net income in the first half of 1997 rose to 955 million pesos compared with 701 million in the same period last year.
The bank said interest income in the first six months totalled 7.87 billion pesos and interest expense at 5.71 billion.
This yielded a net interest margin of 2.16 billion pesos in the first half, up 23 percent from the year-earlier 1.76 billion pesos.
Fee-based and other income for the period amounted to 1.98 billion pesos in the first half, up 15 percent from 1.72 billion in the same period last year.
The bank said total assets reached 211.95 billion pesos as of June 30, 21 percent higher than the year-earlier 175.05 billion pesos.

Deposits during the period rose 18 percent to 157.99 billion pesos at the end of June from 133.66 billion last year, while loans surged 44 percent to 115.79 billion pesos from 80.22 billion, the bank said.
